name: Hotel Milderer Hof
beschreibung: The Hotel Milderer Hof is located in Neustift im Stubaital. The surrounding mountain landscape makes hikes possible in summer and use of the ski areas in winter, including the Stubaier Gletscher. The hotel has a restaurant, a wellness area, and rooms with a balcony. The atmosphere is quiet and focused on relaxation. Guests use the hotel as a base for activities in nature. Regional cuisine is offered at the hotel.
